{{quotation|[[Master Dungeon Guide]]|Remnants of the [[Ebon Vanguard]] survived in the Catacombs of Kathandrax. While on a mission to recover a legendary weapon, they were ambushed by overwhelming [[Charr]] forces. Captain Langmar made it clear to her troops: recovering [[Hammer of Kathandrax|Kathandrax's Crusher]] was of utmost importance. Broken and weary, the remaining Vanguard found little solace, for they found the caves infested with fire [[elemental]]s and other terrible creatures. Their numbers few, they no longer had the strength to reach the artifact. Because its immense power would surely aid the Ebon Vanguard in the ongoing battle against the Charr, we had no choice but to help them retrieve it. Kathandrax's Crusher was hidden deep beneath the raging fires of [[Sacnoth Valley]], protected by a [[Ilsundur, Lord of Fire|fiery elemental lord]].}}

The [[Catacombs of Kathandrax]] is an ancient tomb for the [[Dwarf|Dwarven]] hero, [[Kathandrax Steelsoul]]. It is located in the southeast of Sacnoth Valley.

==Rewards==
*[[Ebon Vanguard rank|Ebon Vanguard reputation points]]
**First time: 1,500 (2,250 in [[hard mode]])
**On repeat: 750 (1,125 in hard mode)

==Notes==
*If you do not have the required quest, you cannot advance beyond the door on the first level before the first collector near the [[Torn Cloth]].
*Killing a [[Becalmed Djinn]] on level 3 will cause a number of hidden monsters to [[spawn]]. 
*[[Fire Jet]] and [[Fire Dart]] turrets can be disabled by killing the [[Flame Guardian]]s.
*This dungeon has many foes that are not [[fleshy]].
*Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #1 of the [[Master Dungeon Guide]] [[storybook]].
{{Bug|[[Roaring Ether]]s sometimes spawn inside a wall and walk through a wall in level 2 and get stuck.}}
